_comment: PictureBook V3 renderer capabilities per model FAMILY (design section 15). Read through
org.cote.accountmanager.olio.illustration.RendererCapabilities.forModel(checkpointName): families
are tried in order, the first whose glob matches wins, and a name no family matches returns null -
the caller degrades per section 19 rather than guessing. Globs are case-insensitive and are tried
against the full checkpoint name and then its file basename, so a deployment that names
checkpoints 'Flux/flux2Klein_9b.safetensors' still lands on 'flux2*'.
Field names are section 15's, verbatim: maxReferences, supportsReferences, supportsStyleReferences,
supportsInitImage, supportsMasks, supportsRegionalPrompt, supportsSeedReplay, supportsCancel,
supportsBatch, recommendedSteps {low, default, high}, cfgRange [lo, hi], nativeResolutions [[w, h]],
secondsPerStepPerReference. 'enabled: false' means the family is known but refused (Kontext is
retired, section 37; no checkpoint is installed on .39, section 36.1).
Provenance of the seed values:
flux2*   steps 4 is the distilled flux2Klein_9b figure and the shipped flux2Defaults.json value;
24 is a non-distilled flux2 checkpoint (20-28, flux2Defaults.json). cfg 1.0-3.5 is the
edit/reference-model range there ('do NOT use the SDXL cfg'). maxReferences 3 is the
structural left/right/setting count in SceneCompositeUtil. 1024x768 is the classic
pipeline size; 1024x1024 the model's square native.
*xl*     steps 20 and cfg 7 are olio.sd.config's schema defaults (configModel.json); the 5-7 cfg
band is flux2Defaults.json's note; 1024x1024 is SDXL's native (SDUtil mannequin note).
The low/high step figures (12 / 30) are a judgement, not a measurement.
secondsPerStepPerReference: flux2* 5.0 is derived from the P5-0 spike figures measured on .39
(2026-10-24, section 38.5: a 3-reference 1024x768 / 4-step BASE at ~102 s warm vs 38.6 s with no
reference -> (102 - 38.6) / 4 / 3 = 5.3). Stephen ratified the measurements and '(b) seeded by
(a)'; the rounding to 5.0 is the implementer's (Implementation 6.C 205). Design section 34 Q14 (b)
makes the per-server calibration record the live figure in P5-2; this is only its seed.
*xl* and *kontext* stay null: no reference-bearing SDXL/Kontext render has been timed on .39, and
an estimate that needs a figure the family lacks must say it has none (sections 15 and 18). Any
figure here is a seed for an estimate, never a pass/fail threshold.
inpaint {steps, creativity, maskGrow, maskBlur} (added P5-1, section 38.2) is the per-actor
ACTOR_REGION stage's parameters: a masked init-image pass over the BASE at full canvas size,
start_at_step = round(steps * (1 - creativity)). flux2* supportsMasks is now true - the P5-0 spike
ran a FLUX.2 one-box inpaint on .39 (77.5 s). The flux2* figures (4 steps, creativity 1.0) are the
spike's inpaint_A_flux2 shape with creativity raised to 1.0 pending P5-1's measure-both comparison
(Stephen 2026-10-24: 'measure both first' - more steps vs creativity 1.0); the *xl* figures
(25 steps, creativity 0.6) are the spike's inpaint_A_sdxl shape as measured (15.1 s). maskGrow 16
/ maskBlur 8 are the spike's SwarmMaskGrow / SwarmMaskBlur values on both. A family with no
inpaint block cannot run the stage.
promptTokenBudget (added P2-4, section 14) is the positive-prompt budget the compiler truncates
to, recorded as a PROMPT_TRUNCATED degradation (section 19). The figures are judgements, not
measured encoder limits: *xl* 225 = three 75-token CLIP chunks, flux2* 512 for the T5 encoder,
*kontext* 225 (disabled anyway). The estimator (PromptBudget.estimateTokens) is a whitespace /
punctuation approximation - the repo has no CLIP BPE tokenizer - so the budget is a soft bound.
nativeResolutions is advisory: CanvasResolver snaps to 64 px, it does not pick from this list;
832x1216 / 1216x832 are the SDXL portrait / landscape page buckets.
